fidelity: F2a — Full Electrochemical Model with Thermal ODE
source: Vincent & Bessarabov (2018) Renew. Sustain. Energy Rev. 81, 1690-1704; Henkensmeier et al. (2021) J. Electrochem. Energy Conv. Storage 18, 024001; Liu et al. (2022) J. Power Sources 524, 231087; Ulleberg (2003) Int. J. Hydrogen Energy 28, 21-33 (thermal lumped balance)

unit.name: Generic 2.5 kW AEM Electrolyser Stack — Physics-Lumped Electrochemical

t_mem.note: AEM membrane thickness (50 um, e.g. Sustainion / FAA-3)

sigma_mem_ref.note: OH- ionic conductivity of AEM at T_ref in 1 M KOH (Vincent 2018; lower than Nafion H+ transport)

Ea_sigma.note: Activation energy for OH- conduction (Arrhenius temperature dependence of membrane conductivity)

r_electrolyte.note: Area-specific resistance of circulating KOH electrolyte + bubbles

j0_anode_ref.note: Anode OER exchange current density on non-noble Ni/NiFe catalyst at T_ref (alkaline)

j0_cathode_ref.note: Cathode HER exchange current density on Ni-based catalyst at T_ref (alkaline)

j_L.note: Mass-transport limiting current density (OH- / bubble removal limit)

eta_F_max.note: Max Faradaic efficiency (gas crossover lower than PEM)
